run_vllm_benchmark: run vLLM offline inference throughput benchmark with configurable engine args and sampling params
run_vllm_async_benchmark: run vLLM async engine throughput benchmark using merge_async_iterators for concurrent generation
run_hf_benchmark: run HuggingFace backend throughput benchmark with optional torch compile and batching
get_benchmark_requests: get benchmark requests from sharegpt, random, sonnet, burstgpt, or hf datasets with tokenizer
validate_benchmark_args: validate command-line arguments for backend, dataset, lora, and distributed settings
save_pytorch_benchmark: save benchmark results to PyTorch benchmark JSON format with throughput metrics
